nodes.label: Organ component
nodes.definition: Cardinal organ part, each instance of which is bounded predominantly by some bonafide boundaries.  Examples: lobe of lung, osteon, acinus, submucosa, anterior leaflet of mitral valve, fibrous capsule of kidney, compact bone, striated muscle fasciculus.

nodes.label: Subcortical gray matter
nodes.definition: Gray matter component of neuraxis which is located in the interior of the neuraxis. Example: thalamus, dentate nucleus, ventral horn of spinal cord.

nodes.label: Segment of neuraxis
nodes.definition: Organ segment which is a regional part of neuraxis. Examples: brain, brainstem, spinal cord.

nodes.label: Brodmann area 37 of middle occipital gyrus
Segment of gyrus of parietal lobe
Hippocampus
nodes.definition: Gyrus of limbic lobe, each instance of which is convoluted mass of gray matter extending the entire length of the floor of the temporal horn of some lateral ventricle; it is part of some limbic system and plays major roles in short term memory and spatial navigation.

nodes.label: Region of cortex of occipital lobe
Region of cell part cluster of neuraxis
Segment of cell part cluster of neuraxis
Lobule III of hemisphere of cerebellum
Lobule IV of hemisphere of cerebellum
Lobule VIIA of hemisphere of cerebellum
Lobule IX of hemisphere of cerebellum
Anatomical structure
nodes.definition: Material anatomical entity which is generated by coordinated expression of the organism's own genes that guide its morphogenesis; has inherent 3D shape; its parts are connected and spatially related to one another in patterns determined by coordinated gene expression. Examples: embryo, mesoderm, heart, right ventricle, mitral valve, myocardium, endothelium, lymphocyte, fibroblast, thorax, cardiovascular system, hemoglobin, T cell receptor.

nodes.label: Occipital part of head
nodes.definition: Subdivision of head proper which consists of the occipital bone and all layers superficial to it. Examples: There is only one occipital part of head.

nodes.label: Anatomical cluster
nodes.definition: Postnatal anatomical structure, each instance of which has as it direct parts a heterogeneous collection of some instances of two or more subclasses of anatomcial structure, which are spatially related to one another; the collections as a whole does not satisfy the definition of any other subclass of anatomical structure. Eaxmples: root of lung, back, anatomical snuffbox, motor unit, juxtaglomerular complex.

nodes.label: Anatomical set
nodes.definition: Material anatomical entity which consists of a maximum number of some instances of discontinuous members of the same class. Examples: set of cranial nerves, ventral branches of aorta, set of mammary arteries, set of thoracic viscera, dentition.

nodes.label: Cavitated organ
nodes.definition: Organ, each instance of which has as its direct parts instances of some organ cavity and organ wall. Examples: stomach, urinary bladder, gall bladder.

nodes.label: Organ with organ cavity
nodes.definition: Cavitated organ in which its unshared parts surround one continuous anatomical space. Examples: stomach, urinary bladder, esophagus, uterine tube.

nodes.label: Segment of brain
nodes.definition: Segment of neuraxis with one or more fixed or anchored fiat boundaries. Examples: thalamus, midbrain, pons, cerebellum, and spinal cord.

nodes.label: Compartment of head
nodes.definition: Anatomical compartment which is located in head.

nodes.label: Physical anatomical entity
nodes.definition: Anatomical entity, each instance of which has three or fewer spatial dimensions. Examples: hemoglobin molecule, mitochondrion, hepatocyte, erythrocyte, heart, head, blood, urine, peritoneal cavity, diaphragmatic surface of heart, inferior margin of liver, apex of lung.

nodes.label: Cardinal segment of brain
nodes.definition: Segment of brain with one or more fixed or anchored fiat boundaries. Examples: thalamus, midbrain, pons, cerebellum, and medulla oblongata.

nodes.label: Cerebral hemisphere
nodes.definition: Segment of telencephalon which has as its direct proper parts cerebral cortex and cerebral medulla.

nodes.label: Gray matter structure of cerebral hemisphere
Lobe of cerebral hemisphere
nodes.definition: Segment of cerebral hemisphere demarcated by both bonafide landmarks (sulci and fissures) and fiat boundaries.

nodes.label: Temporal lobe
nodes.definition: Temporal lobe is the ventrolateral lobe of five lobes comprising each cerebral hemisphere.  It is bounded dorsally by the lateral fissure and posteriorly by an arbitrary border shared with the occipital lobe.

nodes.label: Parietal lobe
nodes.definition: Parietal lobe is the one of five lobes of the cerebral hemisphere which occupies the dorsal-posterior portion of the hemisphere.  It is bounded by the central sulcus on its anterior border and and by the longitudinal cerebral fissure on its medial border. Posteriorly it shares an arbitrary border with the occipital lobe.

nodes.label: Caudate nucleus
nodes.definition: Nucleus of  brain which is an elongated crescent-shaped mass lying parallel and adjacent to the lateral ventricle throughout its extent.

nodes.label: Putamen
nodes.definition: Nucleus of  brain which lies ventral to the caudate nucleus and internal capsule and medial to the external capsule.

nodes.label: Globus pallidus
nodes.definition: Nucleus of  brain which is located medially to the putamen and laterally to the internal capsule.

nodes.label: Amygdala
nodes.definition: Basal ganglion of telencephalon  which is an almond-shaped gray mass in the dorsomedial part of the temporal lobe.

nodes.label: Metencephalon
nodes.definition: Rostral segment of the hindbrain that has as its parts the pons and the cerebellum.

nodes.label: Midbrain tegmentum
nodes.definition: Subdivision of the midbrain lying anterior to the tectum and posterior to the substantia nigra and cerebral peduncle.

nodes.label: Anatomical entity
nodes.definition: Organismal continuant entity which is enclosed by the bona fide boundary of an organism or is an attribute of its structural organization. Examples: cell, heart, head, peritoneal cavity, apex of lung, anatomical term, sagittal plane.

nodes.label: Heterogeneous anatomical cluster
nodes.definition: Anatomical cluster which has as its direct parts all or some members of two or more organ subclasses and one or more organ part subclasses which are grouped together according to some shared attributes. Examples: larynx, internal ear, pharynx.

nodes.label: Organ part cluster
nodes.definition: Anatomical cluster which has as its direct parts all or some members of one or more organ part types which are grouped together according to some shared attributes. Examples: root of lung, internal nose, soft palate, wall of gut, periorbita.

nodes.label: Postnatal anatomical structure
nodes.definition: Anatomical structure present after birth.

nodes.label: Material anatomical entity
nodes.definition: Physical anatomical entity, each instance of which has mass. Examples: hemoglobin molecule, mitochondrion, hepatocyte, erythrocyte, heart, head, blood, urine.

nodes.label: Gray matter of neuraxis
nodes.definition: Cell part cluster consisting predominantly of somas of neurons in the brain and the spinal cord.

nodes.label: Occipital lobe
nodes.definition: Occipital lobe is the one of five lobes of the cerebral hemisphere which occupies the posterior-most portion of the hemisphere.  Anteriorly, it shares an arbitrary border with the parietal lobe and temporal lobe.  Medially, it is bounded by the longitudinal cerebral fissure.

nodes.label: Insula
nodes.definition: Lobe of cerebral hemispheere located in the depths of the lateral fissure and is covered by portions of the frontal, parietal and temporal lobes.

nodes.label: Subdivision of cardinal body part
nodes.definition: anatomical structure, each instance of which is a regional part of some cardinal body part; it has as its constitutional part some subdivision of the integument, such that for each instance of cardinal body part the meronymic sum of its cardinal subdivisions constitutes the instance of cardinal body part. Examples: thorax, perineum, back of neck, forearm, hand, phalanx, nose, auricle of ear, scrotum.

nodes.label: Organ region
nodes.definition: Cardinal organ part, each instance of which is a fiat subdivision of some organ. Examples: lingula of left lung, tail of pancreas, artery, trochanter, nodulus of semilunar valvule, right side of heart, duodenum, fundus of stomach.

nodes.label: Hindbrain
nodes.definition: Organ component of neuraxis that has as its parts the pons, cerebellum and medulla oblongata . Examples: There is only one hindbrain.

nodes.label: Pons
nodes.definition: Organ component of neuraxis that has as its parts the pontine tegmentum and basal part of pons. Examples: There is only one pons.

nodes.label: Substantia nigra
nodes.definition: Subdivision of the midbrain anterior to the midbrain tegmentum which contains darkly pigmented neurons.

nodes.label: Pontine tegmentum
nodes.definition: Dorsal subdivision of the pons. It contains cranial nerve nuclei, reticular and other nuclei and many descending and ascending fiber pathways.

nodes.label: Set of cells
nodes.definition: Anatomical set which has as its direct members cells of same type or of different types.

nodes.label: Set of serotoninergic cells in median raphe nucleus [B6]
Vermis part of anterior lobe of cerebellum
Hemisphere of posterior lobe of cerebellum
Vermis part of posterior lobe of cerebellum
Cardinal organ part
nodes.definition: Anatomical structure, each instance of which has as its direct parts some instance of portions of two or more types of tissue and is continuous with some instance of one or more anatomical structures, likewise constituted by some portions of two or more tissues distinct from those of their complement.

nodes.label: Cell part cluster
nodes.definition: Anatomical cluster which has as direct parts cell parts from two or more cells.

nodes.label: Organ component of neuraxis
nodes.definition: Organ component which is part of the brain or spinal cord.

nodes.label: Segment of white matter of neuraxis
Nucleus of neuraxis
nodes.definition: Subcortical gray matter which has as its direct proper parts predominantly discrete aggregate of somas of neurons. Example:  dentate nucleus, red nucleus.

nodes.label: Nucleus of brain
nodes.definition: Nucleus of neuraxis which is located within the brain. Example: pontobulbar nucleus, globose nucleus.

nodes.label: Gyrus of brain
nodes.definition: Segment of cerebral hemisphere which has as its direct proper parts cortical gray matter bounded by sulcal and surface fiat anatomical boundaries.

nodes.label: White matter of neuraxis
nodes.definition: Cell part cluster consisting predominantly of neurites in the brain and the spinal cord.

nodes.label: Zone of cell part cluster of neuraxis
Medial nucleus of medial dorsal nucleus of thalamus
Region of organ component
nodes.definition: Cardinal organ part. each instance of which is a fiat subdivision of some organ component. Examples: wall of cervical part of esophagus, mucosa of body of stomach.

nodes.label: Organ segment
nodes.definition: Organ region, each instance of which has one or more anchored fiat boundaries. Examples: artery, cervical part of esophagus, pelvic part of vagina, horn of thyroid cartilage, anterior segment of eyeball.

nodes.label: Anatomical compartment
nodes.definition: Anatomical cluster which has as its parts one or more anatomical structures surrounding an anatomical compartment space and the contents of that space. Examples: mediastinum, anterior compartment of forearm, renal sinus, interscalene triangle
